summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a technical report on the McIlvenna Bay Project in Saskatchewan, prepared under NI 43-101 standards. The filing notes that as of April 14, 2026, Foran Mining Corporation became a wholly owned subsidiary of Eldorado, but only updates the report to reflect this acquisition and reassigns a qualified person. No new transaction, tender offer, or corporate action is announced; this is a routine technical report submission. The filing is neutral and does not constitute a special situation; it is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer.
